claim: Reported PJM bill impacts show how aggregate data-centre growth can reach households: roughly +$21 per month in Pepco, +$18 in western Maryland, and +$16 in Ohio.
shortLabel: Current household bill impacts in PJM
comparisonContext: These regional examples make the difference between per-unit estimates and aggregate system effects concrete.
scopeNote: Regional bill impacts tied to current PJM outcomes, not a nationwide forecast.
sourceTitle: Projected data center growth spurs PJM capacity prices by factor of 10
